title: Levels feature rows
description: A warm off-white section: a big left-aligned heading, then feature rows split by hairlines — each a pale green icon tile, tracked eyebrow, large title, grey lead and a two-column list with green dots beside a 1.25 media frame, sides alternating — then a pale green privacy strip with a shield, tracked tag chips and a green link, and one centred ink button.
notes: rows alternate media right / left on desktop; phones always put text first
each row's media fills a 1.25 frame like object-fit: cover; empty, a placeholder stands in
